## Campbell and Heinz (1993), NiAs-type NiS BM3

`nis_campbell_1993_bm3_1` · Executable

Reproduction: **reproduced** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/nis.md#record-nis_campbell_1993_bm3_1)

**Source finding:** K0 and K0' from the BM3 fit paragraph on p. 6 (Figure 1); V0 is computed from the ambient a0 = 3.4395(2) Å and c0 = 5.3514(7) Å on the same page.

    - **Source:** J. Phys. Chem. Solids

Room-temperature BM3 for metastable NiAs-type (B8) NiS. V0 and its error are propagated from the paper's ambient a and c. Above 45 GPa the diffraction lines become unreadable.
